observations: A vertical stack of wooden pallets.
The wood appears light in color and relatively clean.
Various alphanumeric markings are visible on the side blocks/stringers (e.g., 'CEF', '2/26', 'DIPLC').
The photo is a close-up of the stack, obscuring the full dimensions and the condition of the top/bottom surfaces.

risks.risk: Structural damage such as cracked slats or broken blocks hidden within the stack.
risks.proof: Photos of individual pallets laid out separately.

risks.risk: Pest infestation (termites or woodworm) not visible in a low-resolution photo.
risks.proof: High-resolution close-up of the wood grain.

risks.risk: Non-standard dimensions which limit utility for standard racking.
risks.proof: Photo of a pallet with a measuring tape showing length and width.

proof_requests: Photos of individual pallets spread out to inspect the top and bottom slats.
A photo showing the full dimensions of one pallet with a measuring tape.
Clear photo of the IPPC stamp (showing HT for Heat Treated or MB for Methyl Bromide) to determine safety for certain uses.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as wooden pallets. They can be priced at the worst-case value for used, non-standard pallets until further proof of condition and size is provided.
